prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing white sneakers with dark laces and dark pants with a yellow stripe down the side"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P06"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P01 and P06 both show white sneakers with dark laces and dark pants with a visible yellow stripe down the side. Other individuals either lack clear views of the sneakers or the pants do not show a yellow stripe. P02, P03, P04, P05, P07, and P08 either have unclear or no visible yellow stripe on the pants, or the sneakers are not clearly white with dark laces."}

parsed.reason: P01 and P06 both show white sneakers with dark laces and dark pants with a visible yellow stripe down the side. Other individuals either lack clear views of the sneakers or the pants do not show a yellow stripe. P02, P03, P04, P05, P07, and P08 either have unclear or no visible yellow stripe on the pants, or the sneakers are not clearly white with dark laces.
